result.title: Act-HiMotif: Hierarchical Daily Activity Schedule Generation via Learned Activity-Structure Motifs
result.summary: Generating daily activity schedules from individual attributes (e.g., age and income) is valuable for activity-based travel modeling and human behavior simulation. The task is challenging because exact activity structures follow a highly imbalanced, long-tailed distribution, while the same structure can admit multiple duration allocations under a fixed full-day budget. Direct generation must therefore learn many exact activity structures from highly uneven observations while modeling their possible temporal realizations. However, many exact structures share recurring activity organization. Based on this observation, we propose Act-HiMotif, a hierarchical motif-based generative model that introduces learned, reusable activity-structure motifs as an intermediate representation between individual profiles and specific activity structures. Act-HiMotif first distinguishes home-only days from active days, then samples a motif from a profile-conditioned prior to guide activity-structure generation, and finally applies a budget-constrained duration allocator to generate activity durations that sum exactly to the full-day horizon. This hierarchy models home-only routing, activity-structure generation, and duration allocation at their corresponding levels, while motifs allow related structures to share statistical support without losing their distinct sequences. Experiments on large-scale travel survey data show that Act-HiMotif outperforms strong baselines in both in-distribution and spatial generalization settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of hierarchical generation and reusable activity-structure motifs for producing realistic profile-conditioned daily activity schedules.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向出行行为建模，提出分层生成模型 Act-HiMotif：先区分「仅居家日」与「活动日」，再从个体属性条件下的先验中采样可复用的活动结构 motif 作为中间表示，最后用预算约束的时长分配器生成总长恰为整天的活动时长序列。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关系，但其「可复用离散 motif 作为属性与具体序列之间的中间状态」及「固定预算下的资源分配」可能为 LVR 的抽象 latent 状态选择与计算预算/停止决策提供概念类比，值得少量核查。
